# PMU Forms

> PMU Forms is a client management app for permanent makeup (PMU) and beauty artists. Clients fill in and sign consent and intake forms on their phone before they arrive. Artists send pre-care and aftercare emails, run healing check-ins where clients send a photo, sync bookings from Square Appointments, request extra charges through Square payment links, and track pigment and supply lots on each client. It works on iPhone, Android and the web.

Plans: Starter is $9.99 a month for up to 10 clients at a time and 5 appointments a month. Pro is $19.99 a month or $149.99 a year with unlimited clients and appointments. Both plans include every feature. Creating an account is free; a subscription is needed to send forms to clients.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://pmuforms.com/): what PMU Forms does, the client journey from booking to healed results, and frequently asked questions
- [Pricing](https://pmuforms.com/pricing): Starter and Pro plans, what's included, and billing questions
- [Free form templates](https://pmuforms.com/templates): free printable PMU consent, intake and aftercare templates
- [Contact](https://pmuforms.com/contact): reach the PMU Forms team
- [Web app](https://artist.pmuforms.com/): sign up or sign in
